title: RichAuto A11 post: optional G55-G59 offsets, a manual tool change, and inch output

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

- The RichAuto DSP A11 post writes work offset 1 only. It writes no G54 word. It refuses each other offset (`assets/posts/richauto.cps:15-16`, `:222-224`, `:391-397`).
- The post refuses a second tool (`richauto.cps:417-420`). The post does not declare `manualToolChange`. Thus the engine refuses a machine with a manual tool change (`crates/post/src/post/manual_change.rs:24-40`).
- The post writes mm only (`richauto.cps:13`). The engine refuses an inch document before any hook runs (`crates/post/src/post/units.rs:35-54`). Thus the check in the post at `richauto.cps:159-164` never runs. It is dead code.

These refusals are safe. The post makes no wrong output.

## Expected

- The A11 manuals list G54 to G59 when the pendant is set to `Read G54`. A post option enables these offsets.
- The A11 manuals list `M06` and `T` when the pendant is set to `Read T`, and they show a manual bit change with a fixed tool setter. A post mode writes a stop for the bit change and then the Z re-measure.
- The A11 manuals list G20 and G21. Inch output is optional.
- Each of these is opt-in. The default output does not change: offset 1 with no G54 word, one tool, and mm.

## Evidence

Main `8937e684d`, at the lines above. Sources: the RichAuto DSP A11 user manual (G-code and M-code list, pendant settings). The #1907 research says that many A11 users ignore G54, that a bare `M6` can halt a manual machine, and that G21 prevents scale errors. Thus the defaults stay.

Found by the post audit against the RichAuto manuals (#4130).

## Done means

- A post option enables G54 to G59 for `Read G54` pendants. Offset 1 with no word stays the default.
- The post declares `manualToolChange` for one mode. That mode writes a stop for the bit change and then the Z re-measure. A golden pins it.
- Optional: the post declares `programUnits = "mm inch"` and writes G20 only for an inch document. If this is not done, remove the dead check at `richauto.cps:159-164`.
- Each new path has a conformance golden. The current goldens do not change.
